title: malva microphylla
intro: Malva microphylla, commonly known as the dwarf mallow or small mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and relieving respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Malva microphylla include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
